lead: Picks a time: the trigger matches [Select](/select), the popup holds scrollable hour / minute / second columns. Clicking an option changes the value at once, no need to click OK. Steps, an earliest / latest time and a 12-hour clock are available. For a date and a time, use `showTime` on [DatePicker](/date-picker).

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `time-picker.css`; the trigger is `select-trigger`, the popup shell is `popover`.
styling.column: The panel and each column (a listbox; `data-column` is hour / minute / second / period)
styling.option: Each option; `data-selected` when selected, `data-disabled` when disabled
styling.footer: Footer: Now on the left, Clear and OK on the right
styling.datetime: When DatePicker shows a time, the container holding the calendar and the time panel side by side
